subject: Disable auto-update + fix Claude API key setup
body:
Disable auto-update + fix Claude API key setup

- frmMain: early return in CheckForUpdates() — fork would break with upstream updates
- ClaudeChatWindow: load API key from env var or saved file instead of throwing;
  add 'cgo --setkey sk-ant-...' command to set and persist the key from the chat panel

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
